Quick proposal: to respect everyone's time across ET/IST, we can either:
- Do one 60-minute session that starts late morning ET (so Priya can join early evening IST), or
- Split into two back-to-back blocks: 30min product demo (for Tim) + 30–45min technical deep-dive for Priya/Raj with Marcus.

Three slot options (all ET):
1) Tue Nov 9 — 11:00–12:00 ET (20:30–21:30 IST)
2) Wed Nov 10 — 09:00–10:00 ET (18:30–19:30 IST)
3) Thu Nov 11 — 14:00–15:00 ET (23:30–00:30 IST — late for IST folks)

Please let us know which option works or suggest alternatives. Also, happy to send a two-part calendar invite if splitting looks better. Attached is a draft agenda and a short deployment diagram that Marcus will reference.

Attachments: demo-agenda-v2.pdf, deployment-diagram.png

—
